title: Token latency heatmap and cache-shadow attribution modeling
creator: Asha Nair
description: Build a token-level latency heatmap and a cache-shadow attribution model to produce per-token cost and latency signals suitable for dashboards and downstream billing/alerting. This ticket focuses on the modeling, synthetic replay harness, and the metric export surface (Prometheus + event logs) rather than visualization UX. The output must enable: 1) per-request breakdowns that explain tail latency by token positions and cache hits, and 2) aggregated heatmaps to surface patterns across models/regions/sequence lengths.
rationale: Current request-level traces mask hot spans across token positions and batching boundaries. Engineers and SREs need a way to correlate cache behavior with token emission latency patterns to: reduce tail latency, tune batching/eviction heuristics, and improve cost allocation for dedicated tenants.
technical_notes: We'll implement a small, low-overhead sampling shim in the inference runtime that records per-token relative timings (microsecond precision) and a compact cache event stream (hit/miss + key fingerprint). To avoid high cardinality, token-level events will be sampled with a deterministic reservoir by request-id and hashed token bucket. A separate offline replay harness will ingest raw recordings and synthesize heatmaps by aligning token positions across varying batch sizes and kv-cache states.
implementation_plan: Instrument runtime: lightweight per-token timers + cache event API (C++/Rust change)
Add deterministic sampler: config toggle, rate and hash-bucket controls
Export wire format: compressed newline-delimited protobuf -> kafka/topic
Build replay harness: consumer that reconstructs per-request timelines and annotates cache-shadowed tokens
Compute aggregates: heatmap generator job that emits Prometheus summaries + percentile histograms
Backfill dashboards: Grafana panel and example alerts for token-position tail latency
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits sampled per-token timeline events under the new topic with <5% added p95 overhead on instrumented requests
Replay harness reconstructs >95% of sampled request timelines and produces token-position latency histograms per model and region
Heatmap generator produces weekly and hourly views and exposes prometheus metrics: token_position_p50_ms, token_position_p95_ms, token_position_p99_ms, cache_hit_ratio_by_position
SRE and two backend PMs have reviewed and approved the metric semantics and sampling knobs
Unit and integration tests for sampler determinism and replay alignment are present in CI
rollout: staged: dev cluster -> staging -> canary on dedicated pool -> full rollout
test_plan: Microbench: measure runtime overhead on synthetic workloads (short/long sequences, batched/unbatched)
Determinism test: same request ID and seed produce same sampled events
Replay accuracy test: shadow-replay matches original timeline within 2% median timing error
End-to-end smoke: heatmap generation pipeline runs on a 24h sampled dataset
